messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 detected - canary deploy failing (db migration errors) on region us-west-2. Error rate spike + elevated latency. Auto-incident created: INC-2027-042. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.example/inc/INC-2027-042

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2027.04.12-rc3 started at 21:33 UTC. New migration v20270412_add_user_flags.sql applied to canaries.

Eli: I'm oncall, jumping in. seeing 500s from canaries and a lot of db timeouts. pulling logs now.

Maya: queued behind a meeting, can take handoff in ~10 if you need me now.

Eli: quick snapshot of error from canary logs:
```
SQLState: 42P01 ERROR: column "user_flags" does not exist at character 215
  query: SELECT user_flags FROM user_profile WHERE id = $1
```
Seems migration added column but canary service expects it in a different table. suspect migration and code are out of sync (backwards-incompatible).

Jon: Confirmed: migration v20270412 created table user_flags instead of adding column to user_profile. Looks like a naming mismatch in migration file.

Priya: Customers impacted? Support show any tickets?

Amy: Support: small set of customers hitting app errors where profile toggles fail. ~12 accounts, two paying customers reported degraded UX. No revenue-impacting alerts yet, but escalations incoming.

Eli: Immediate plan: pause rollout, enable feature-flag kill-switch for new profile feature, and rollback canary pods to previous image. Also check DB for any partial DDL applied.

Jon: running rollout pause: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/user-service -n prod --selector=canary=true`

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused (2027-04-12T21:40:12Z).

Eli: feature flag toggle: `/feature-flag kill user-profile-v2` -> toggled to off. Confirmed no new traffic to new endpoints.

Maya: I'm taking oncall. Eli handing off. Handover: root cause likely migration script authoring error (wrong target), race where code deployed expecting column on user_profile but migration created separate table. Need rollback migration or fast fix.

Eli: Notes saved to incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.example/inc/INC-2027-042/notes

Priya: DB team: can we check whether DDL was applied on primary or only on canary DBs? If only canaries, we can revert easily.

Jon: Checking primary cluster: only canary DB instances show the new table. Primary replicas unaffected. Good. Means canary traffic caused migration to run only on canary DB pool (migration job was targeted at canary pool) -> safer.

Maya: Great. Steps then: 1) ensure canary DB has no customer data transformed; 2) drop the incorrectly created table on canary DBs; 3) rollback canary code to previous image and re-run migrations correctly in staging; 4) update migration script to add column to user_profile instead of creating new table; 5) reopen rollout after validation.

Eli: I'll run quick validation script to list tables and check any FK side effects. Running: `psql -c "\dt user_flags*"`

Jon: I can drop table on canary DB if confirmed safe. Running in 2.

Amy: Support notified affected customers with rollback-in-progress note. Template sent.

Maya: After drop and rollback, we should keep canary paused and run a canary-only smoke test for profile reads/writes. assign @Jon and @Eli.

Eli: Doing smoke test after rollback. Will report results.

deploy-bot: Canary pods rolled back to image user-service:v20270329 at 21:48 UTC.

Jon: Dropped table `user_flags` on canary DBs. No dependent objects found. Verified by checksum of schema diff: `diff shows only dropped table`.

Eli: Smoke tests: read/write profile passes on canary after rollback. latency back to baseline.

Amy: Customer update sent: "We observed degraded profile toggles for a subset of customers during a canary. We've paused the rollout and reverted the service. No data loss detected. We'll follow up with a timeline for a corrected release."

Maya: OK we have mitigation in place. I'll coordinate a postmortem and a code + migration test plan.

Eli: Handoff complete to Maya for incident cleanup and post-incident follow up. Leaving pager.

Maya: Taking incident lead. Next steps: run migration-in-staging with added integration test, add preflight DDL checker to deploy pipeline, and add a migration owner signoff for future DB changes. Will post timeline in INC doc.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027-042 marked as mitigated by oncall at 21:58 UTC.

Amy: Closing loop with customers, will keep channel updated if any follow-ups come in.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Good catch.
